title: fix(console): the Public Forms page lists a form as published by the server's one rule, on the ViewItem shape it serves (objectui#11545)
body:
Fixes #11545

Clause-②: no

## What this changes

The developer Public Forms page lists a form as published exactly when the server's anonymous form routes serve it. Before, it read `sharing.allowAnonymous` and a parseable link, and never `sharing.enabled`. So a form withdrawn by clearing `enabled` still showed as published, although the routes answer it with `404 FORM_NOT_FOUND`.

All of it is in `apps/console/src/pages/developer/PublicFormsPage.tsx`, the tests beside it, and one changeset. This is triage's amended scope (objectui#11545 comment `6029934416`, items 1 to 4):

1. **The published read is the server's rule, imported.** For each item `GET /meta/view` serves, the page calls `anonymousFormIntakeCandidates` from `@objectstack/spec/ui`. It lists one row per candidate, under the slug the rule yields. `@objectstack/metadata-core` re-exports the same binding to the anonymous routes (`registerFormEndpoints`), and those routes scan the same list. The page's own reading and its private slug parser (`slugFromLink`) are deleted. No local reading of the three keys is left.
   - Form detection moves to the `ViewItem` shape. A form view is offered under **Publish** when it is `viewKind: 'form'` with a `config`, and the rule does not open it. That includes a withdrawn form.
   - The page now passes the rule the item exactly as served. The `it.spec ?? it` wrapper arm is gone: no served list wraps items in `spec`.
2. **The Publish and Edit writers write `config`.** Both used to write `sharing` at the item's top level, and Edit also wrote `submitBehavior` there. Both keys now go under `config`, where the rule and `ViewItemSchema` read them. The Edit dialog also reads the stored `submitBehavior` from `config`.
   - Edit's `submitBehavior` was not named in triage's item 2. It moved with `sharing` because it is written by the same writer, sits on the same layer, and gets the same refusal (measured below). Leaving it on top would have made every Edit save drop the post-submit behaviour.
3. **The module header and the Publish dialog copy name the server's rule.** The dialog now says that publishing sets `sharing.enabled`, `sharing.allowAnonymous` and `sharing.publicLink` in the view's config, and that the public route serves a form only when all three are set. This is inline copy, with no language-pack key.
4. **Fixtures move to the `ViewItem` shape.** The page's five existing suites move: `emptyPlaceholderAffordance-8504`, `publicUrlBasename-11769`, `redirect`, `sharedSelect-11865`, and the Public Forms half of `developerMetadataEnvelope.contractEnvelope-6917`. Each fixture drops the `{ spec }` wrapper and the top-level form keys, and puts the form under `config`. The `sharedSelect` write literals and the `redirect` write assertions now expect the form under `config`.

Route: ruling `5967405932`'s second door. The console already depends on `@objectstack/spec` (`^18.0.0-next.1`), and `@objectstack/spec/ui` is already imported at runtime in `apps/console`, by `components/submitRedirect.ts`, which this page imports. No dependency is added. No export, prop or language-pack key is added.

## Measured before code (the dispatch's mechanism assumptions)

- **A1, holds.** From `apps/console` on this worktree, the card's probe `node -e "import('@objectstack/spec/ui').then(m=>process.exit(typeof m.anonymousFormIntakeCandidates==='function'?0:1))"` exits **0**. A negative control (a name the module does not export) exits **1**. The installed `@objectstack/spec` is `18.0.0-next.1`.
- **A2, holds.** At base `6f3299fe7`, the old reading (`if (sharing?.allowAnonymous && slug && link)`), the two writers (`allowAnonymous: true`), the module header and the dialog copy were where the PM's grep put them.
- **A3, holds, and it is sharper on `18.0.0-next.1`.** Measured with `safeParse` against the installed schemas:
  - `ViewItemSchema` (the strict authoring face) refuses a top-level `sharing` on a form ViewItem with `unrecognized_keys`, keys `sharing`, path root. It refuses a top-level `submitBehavior` the same way.
  - `ViewItemSchema` accepts `config.sharing` and `config.submitBehavior`.
  - `ViewMetadataSchema`, which the save path parses a `view` body with, **accepts** a top-level `sharing`, but drops it from the parsed value. Neither the top level nor `config` carries it afterwards. So a Publish on the old writer would have saved without opening the form.
  - `config.sharing` survives that parse unchanged.
- **A4, holds.** At the `@objectstack/spec@18.0.0-next.1` tag of objectstack, `getMetaItems` filters every aggregated `defineView` container out of a `view` enumeration (`isAggregatedViewContainer`). So `GET /meta/view` serves `ViewItem`s whose form sits under `config`. `expandViewContainer` in the installed spec builds each form item as `name`, `object`, `viewKind: 'form'`, `label`, `config` (the form body, `sharing` and `submitBehavior` included), `order` and `scope`. The anonymous routes' `findPublicFormView` scans the same `getMetaItems({ type: 'view' })` list, through the same function. The page now feeds the rule each item as served, so no input shape needs guessing: whichever of the rule's three shapes an item carries, the page and the routes get the same answer.

## Tests

New suite `PublicFormsPage.servedRule-11545.test.tsx`. Its fixture is the showcase's `inquiry.view.ts` `formViews.contact`, which is a real producer, copied verbatim. It runs through `defineView` and `expandViewContainer` from the installed spec, so it is the shape the list serves. It has two siblings:
- `withdrawn`, with `sharing.enabled: false`;
- `two_keys`, which is raw and unparsed, with only `allowAnonymous` and `publicLink`.

Pins:
- **Pin 1:** a form withdrawn under the rule is not listed as published. Neither sibling is listed. The listed set equals the rule's answer, item by item.
- **Pin 2:** the fully opted-in `contact` form is listed, under slug `contact-us`, with its object and its `/f/contact-us` link. Nothing else is listed.
- The Publish picker offers the two forms the rule does not open, and no list view.
- **Pin 3:** Publish writes `config.sharing` and Edit writes `config.sharing` and `config.submitBehavior`. Neither writes a top-level `sharing` or `submitBehavior`. `ViewItemSchema.safeParse` accepts each written body. `anonymousFormIntakeSlugs` of each written body is the slug the dialog was given.
- A fixture case asserts that every fixture item parses as a `ViewItem`, and that the rule opens only `contact`. Its control: the siblings still carry `allowAnonymous: true` and a `/forms/` link, so the old reading would have accepted them.

Runs, all at head `f1bc59665a` (the final commit) unless named otherwise:
- `pnpm exec vitest run` over the six suites that import the page: `Test Files 6 passed (6)`, `Tests 63 passed (63)`, through the verify lock (`VERDICT command-exit 0`).
- `@object-ui/console` full project: `pnpm exec vitest run apps/console/ --maxWorkers=3` gives `Test Files 187 passed (187)` and `Tests 2102 passed (2102)` (`VERDICT command-exit 0`). An earlier run of the same command at `f82679a913` read `2 failed | 2100 passed`. Both failures were in `developerMetadataEnvelope.contractEnvelope-6917`, whose Public Forms fixture still had the legacy shape. Its move is commit `f1bc59665a`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/console type-check` (the script name echoed as `@object-ui/console@17.7.0 type-check`): `VERDICT command-exit 0`. It ran after `turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/console^...' --concurrency=2` built the 34-task dependency closure (`VERDICT command-exit 0`). `tsc --listFiles` over the console `tsconfig.json` lists the page and all six suites, so the type-check covers the tests.

## Ablation (pin 4), run once, recorded here

The mutation was planted on disk with objectstack's `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, in its wrap mode, which restores the file itself. It replaced the page's `const open = anonymousFormIntakeCandidates(item);` with the old `allowAnonymous && slug && link` reading, kept on `item.config` with the old slug parser, plus a marker comment.
- Landed: anchor count 1 to 0, and the file's blob moved from `693d803ae29c` to `eb9119981701`.
- **Run 1 was void.** All five page pins went red, but on the suite's `mount()` helper (`Found multiple elements with the role "button"`), not on a pin assertion. The helper waited for exactly one row. It now waits for every row (commit `b9b85c185`), and the ablation was re-run.
- **Run 2 is the reading.** `Tests 4 failed | 2 passed (6)`.
  - Pin 1 is red on its own assertion: `a form withdrawn by enabled: false: expected [ 'showcase_inquiry.contact', …(2) ] to not include 'showcase_inquiry.withdrawn'`.
  - Pin 2 is red on `and nothing else is`.
  - The picker case and the Publish case are red: the Publish button is disabled, because every form now reads as published.
  - The fixture case and the Edit case stay green, as predicted: Edit writes the same body under either reading.
- **Restore proven.** After the run, the file's blob equals its blob at `HEAD` (`693d803ae29c`), `git diff HEAD` is empty, and the marker count is 0.

## Gates

These ran locally at `f1bc59665a`, each exit code captured before any pipe:
- `check-control-bytes`, `check-new-cross-file-line-citations`, `check-test-path-roots`, `check-vi-mock-specifiers`, `check-vi-mock-inherit` and `check-vi-mock-override-shape`;
- `check-changeset-presence` (`7 source file(s) of 1 released package(s) changed, and this change declares 1 changeset(s)`), `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-changeset-fixed`, `check-changeset-claims` and `check-pending-changeset-literals`;
- `check-spec-symbol-derivation`, `check-object-metadata-write-doors` and `check-unreferenced-sources`.

All of them exit 0.

ESLint over the seven changed source files: 0 errors. The page carries 11 warnings, the same rules and counts as at base (10 `no-explicit-any`, 1 `set-state-in-effect`). The suites carry 0 warnings. CI runs the full farm.

## Acceptance notes (observations, not filed)

- **Not covered here (triage `6029934416`: out of scope until a named user hits it).** The routes also refuse a form that another metadata layer withdraws, and one whose bound object cannot take an anonymous submission on the deployment's tenancy posture. The list read carries neither. So such a form is still listed, while the routes answer it 404. The module header and the changeset both say so.
- **The `/f/:slug` route comment in `apps/console/src/App.tsx`** still states the old two-key rule in prose. Triage's amended item 3 names only the module header and the dialog copy, so it is left alone. Carrier: none.
- **Two objectless fixtures are not valid ViewItems.** One is the `8504` objectless row; the other is the `sharedSelect` survey with no label and no object. `ViewItemSchema` requires `object` and a dotted name. Both rows exist to pin how the page draws an item that names no object. Each fixture's comment says so. On schema-valid served data, the Object column's empty placeholder and the picker's no-object label are not reachable. That is an observation only.
- **A flat form overlay is no longer offered under Publish.** A stored body on the `formOverlay` branch is `viewKind: 'form'` with no `config`. The rule never opens such a body, and writing `config.sharing` onto it would not open it either. The old page offered any form-ish top-level body.
- **Other pages keep their own `spec ?? item` wrapper arm.** These are `FormPage.tsx` (its own read) and `FlowRunsPage.tsx`. They were not touched. This is an observation only.
